conbody.p: To sound the horn, press the area indicated by the horn symbol on your steering wheel (see illustration).
The horn will operate only when this area is pressed. Check the horn regularly to be sure it operates properly.

li.p: Do not strike the horn severely to operate it, or hit it with your fist. Do not press on the horn with a sharp-pointed object.
When cleaning the steering wheel, do not use an organic solvent such as thinner, benzene, alcohol and gasoline. Doing so may damage the steering wheel.
